paragraphs.source_en: I’m at that point when the music of the machines takes hold. The clicks and the clacks, the hisses and the hums reverberate through the hull. A countdown begins.

units.source_en: I’m at that point when the music of the machines takes hold.
The clicks and the clacks, the hisses and the hums reverberate through the hull.

ja.t: カチカチ、ガチャガチャ、シューという

paragraphs.source_en: “Ready over there, Goblin?” I ask Sevro over the com.

units.source_en: I ask Sevro over the com.

paragraphs.source_en: Does a bear shit in the woods? The ship spins and shudders. More sirens howl.

units.source_en: Does a bear shit in the woods?

ja.t: をするか、というやつだ。
「Audentes fortuna juvat」セヴロがくつくつ

paragraphs.source_en: “Fortune favors the bold? You deserve to die if that’s really going to be the last thing you say in this life.”

units.source_en: You deserve to die if that’s really going to be the last thing you say in this life.”

paragraphs.source_en: My heart sticks its downward beat.

units.source_en: My heart sticks its downward beat.

paragraphs.source_en: The metal teeth jerk me forward into the tube’s magnetic stream. And it happens. Even through my suit, g-forces hit me like the backhand of the Obsidians’ thunder god. My vision flickers black. Stomach rises into throat. Lungs constrict. Blood slows in my veins. I snap forward. Lights flicker in my eyes. I don’t see the walls of the tube I’m shot through. I don’t even see the ship that brought me here. I see Eo’s face in the darkness. I black out. Bodies can’t take this. Too fast.

units.source_en: The metal teeth jerk me forward into the tube’s magnetic stream.
Even through my suit, g-forces hit me like the backhand of the Obsidians’ thunder god.
I don’t see the walls of the tube I’m shot through.
I don’t even see the ship that brought me here.
I see Eo’s face in the darkness.

paragraphs.source_en: There’s no meantime. One second I’m on the ship, the next I’m ripping through the deep of space at fifteen times the speed of sound.

ja.t: そのあいだというものがない。

units.source_en: One second I’m on the ship, the next I’m ripping through the deep of space at fifteen times the speed of sound.

paragraphs.source_en: Many shit their suits at this point. It’s not a fear thing. It’s biology and physics. The human body can only take so much. Mickey the Carver made sure mine could take just a little bit more. I hope Sevro can too.

units.source_en: Many shit their suits at this point.
The human body can only take so much.
Mickey the Carver made sure mine could take just a little bit more.

ja.t: えられるようにしてくれた。
セヴロもそうであってほしい。

paragraphs.source_en: I rip soundlessly through space. Trust that Sevro is near me. Can’t see him, even on the sensors. All too fast. Toward the greatest ship in the Scepter Armada—the one we should avoid. It all happens in six seconds. Emergency missiles streak past us. The gunners see us now. Know what’s happening. But we’re not using thrusters, so the missiles can’t lock. Flack can’t detonate on so short a fuse. The unspent canisters fly past us, nearly hitting me. Our pilot took a perfect shot.

units.source_en: Trust that Sevro is near me.
Can’t see him, even on the sensors.

ja.t: えない。センサーにさえ

units.source_en: Toward the greatest ship in the Scepter Armada—the one we should avoid.
It all happens in six seconds.

ja.t: きているかもわかっている。

units.source_en: But we’re not using thrusters, so the missiles can’t lock.

ja.t: っていないので、ミサイルはロックできない。

units.source_en: Flack can’t detonate on so short a fuse.
The unspent canisters fly past us, nearly hitting me.
Our pilot took a perfect shot.

paragraphs.source_en: Railguns miss us. Projectiles flash past. Sevro is howling in the com. Their shields are down. They can’t bring them up fast enough. It takes time. Iridescent blue flickers over their hull as the pulseShields power up. Too late, you sons of bitches.

units.source_en: Sevro is howling in the com.
They can’t bring them up fast enough.
Iridescent blue flickers over their hull as the pulseShields power up.
Too late, you sons of bitches.

ja.t: すぎるんだよ、このくそ

paragraphs.source_en: I can’t think. I’m screaming inside. Laughing like the flames of a wildfire. Laughing because I know it is my madness that these logical warriors cannot fight.

units.source_en: Laughing like the flames of a wildfire.
Laughing because I know it is my madness that these logical warriors cannot fight.
